title: Why Ram Killed the TRX (And What Came Next)

scenes.text: In August twenty twenty-three, Ram told the world that the TRX chapter was coming to a close. Two years and four months later, Ram unveiled a faster one. Between those two announcements, the truck was retired, replaced, shelved, and revived. This is the story of why Ram killed the TRX, what it said, what it did not say, and what came next.
scenes.caption: WHY RAM KILLED THE TRX (AND WHAT CAME NEXT)

scenes.text: We read Wikipedia, KBB, Edmunds, Motor1, SlashGear, Hagerty, the Auto Wire, the Autoblog interview with Ram's chief executive, and Ram's own release. The key question, why it was killed, has no single official answer in what we found. So we show who said what, and we mark every interpretation as an interpretation.
scenes.caption: SOURCES: WIKIPEDIA · KBB · EDMUNDS · MOTOR1 · SLASHGEAR · HAGERTY · THE AUTO WIRE · AUTOBLOG/THE DRIVE · RAM RELEASE · INTERPRETATIONS ARE LABELLED

scenes.text: The announcement came on the thirtieth of August twenty twenty-three. Kelley Blue Book reports that Ram brand chief Tim Kuniskis said: This current chapter in Ram's high-performance trucks is coming to a close, but it's not the end of TRX's story. He added that there would be more news at a later date.
scenes.caption: 30 AUG 2023: KUNISKIS: 'THIS CURRENT CHAPTER ... IS COMING TO A CLOSE, BUT IT'S NOT THE END OF TRX'S STORY' · 'MORE NEWS TO COME AT A LATER DATE' (KBB)

scenes.text: The vehicle announced was the TRX Final Edition. KBB says it started at one hundred seventeen thousand, six hundred twenty-five dollars plus a mandatory nineteen ninety-five destination fee, and was limited to four thousand examples. Orders would open in the fourth quarter of twenty twenty-three, and production would end at the close of the year.
scenes.caption: FINAL EDITION: $117,625 + $1,995 DEST = $119,620 (OUR SUM) · 4,000 UNITS · ORDERS Q4 2023 · 'PRODUCTION ENDS AT THE CLOSE OF 2023' (KBB)

scenes.text: Edmunds, on the thirteenth of September, quoted Ram's own words: the Final Edition was one last chance to buy before the Hellcat engine was axed from the lineup. Edmunds also noted that Stellantis had previously announced the Hellcat motor would not last past twenty twenty-three. So the end had been signalled before the TRX's own announcement.
scenes.caption: EDMUNDS, 13 SEPT 2023: RAM: 'ONE LAST CHANCE' BEFORE THE HELLCAT ENGINE IS 'AXED' · STELLANTIS HAD 'PREVIOUSLY ANNOUNCED' THE HELLCAT MOTOR WOULDN'T LAST PAST 2023

scenes.text: KBB adds context: parent company Stellantis was trimming its Hemi-powered lineup, with the Dodge Charger, Dodge Challenger and Chrysler three hundred ending after twenty twenty-three. SlashGear says the Charger and Challenger ended around twenty twenty-two. Those dates disagree, and our sources do not settle which is right.
scenes.caption: KBB: CHARGER, CHALLENGER, CHRYSLER 300 ENDING AFTER 2023 · SLASHGEAR: CHARGER/CHALLENGER ENDED 'AROUND 2022' · DISAGREE

scenes.text: Look at the Final Edition's details. Motor1 lists three exclusive colours, Delmonico Red, Night Edge Blue and Harvest Sunshine, a Final Edition logo on the instrument cluster, and Patina stitching on the dash and seats. Its price was one hundred nineteen thousand, six hundred twenty dollars including destination, against ninety-seven thousand, seven hundred thirty for the standard truck.
scenes.caption: COLOURS: DELMONICO RED · NIGHT EDGE BLUE · HARVEST SUNSHINE · CLUSTER LOGO · PATINA STITCHING · $119,620 vs $97,730 STANDARD (MOTOR1)

scenes.text: Why? Wikipedia gives a direct answer: the TRX was discontinued after the twenty twenty-four model year because it could not be modified to meet tougher emissions standards. That sentence is the clearest statement we found. But it is Wikipedia's wording, and we could not find Ram or Stellantis saying it in those words.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 'COULD NOT BE MODIFIED TO MEET TOUGHER EMISSIONS STANDARDS' · RAM/STELLANTIS SAYING SO IN THOSE WORDS: NOT FOUND IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: SlashGear is more careful. It says Ram did not officially give specific reasons, and that everything it offers is the author's inference. Its theory links the TRX's end to Stellantis reducing emissions and moving toward electrified vehicles. It quotes Stellantis' goal to reach carbon net zero by twenty thirty-eight, and it does not name any specific emissions rule.
scenes.caption: SLASHGEAR: 'RAM DID NOT OFFICIALLY GIVE SPECIFIC REASONS' · AUTHOR'S THEORY: EMISSIONS + ELECTRIFICATION · STELLANTIS GOAL: CARBON NET ZERO BY 2038 (QUOTED) · NO SPECIFIC RULE NAMED

scenes.text: Hagerty, on the eighth of November twenty twenty-three, quoted Kuniskis about the name. He said: We're not calling it a TRX because I would never call it the same name and have it down in power from what it is today. And he said the TRX name will go on the shelf. The Hemi was also being retired.
scenes.caption: HAGERTY, 8 NOV 2023, KUNISKIS: 'WE'RE NOT CALLING IT A TRX BECAUSE I WOULD NEVER CALL IT THE SAME NAME AND HAVE IT DOWN IN POWER' · THE TRX NAME 'WILL GO ON THE SHELF' · HEMI BEING RETIRED

scenes.text: Hagerty also quotes Ram's chief engineer, Alan Falkowski, tying the Hurricane engine to Stellantis' emissions targets. He said that half of the company's vehicles were expected to be electrified by twenty thirty, so combustion engines still need improving. Hagerty names no specific regulation. So the corporate reasoning is about targets, not about a single rule.
scenes.caption: ALAN FALKOWSKI, CHIEF ENGINEER (HAGERTY): HURRICANE TIED TO EMISSIONS TARGETS · ~HALF OF STELLANTIS VEHICLES ELECTRIFIED BY 2030 · NO SPECIFIC REGULATION NAMED

scenes.text: Add the fuel figures. KBB lists the TRX at ten miles per gallon in the city, fourteen highway and twelve combined. Wikipedia says the American Council for an Energy-Efficient Economy ranked it the worst-performing mass-market vehicle for twenty twenty-one, twenty twenty-two and twenty twenty-three. Neither source says that Ram cited those numbers as a reason.
scenes.caption: EPA 10/14/12 MPG (KBB) · ACEEE WORST-PERFORMING MASS-MARKET VEHICLE 2021–2023 (WIKIPEDIA) · NO SOURCE SAYS RAM CITED THESE AS THE REASON

scenes.text: So our reading, labelled as ours: the sources give several reasons that fit together, a company-wide plan to cut emissions, the Hellcat engine's announced retirement, a shift to the Hurricane six, and a truck with a twelve miles per gallon rating. But no source we read gives Ram's own full statement of why. We will not claim more than that.
scenes.caption: OUR READING (NOT A SOURCED CLAIM): COMPANY EMISSIONS PLAN + HELLCAT RETIREMENT + HURRICANE SHIFT + 12 MPG FIT TOGETHER · RAM'S OWN FULL STATEMENT: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Production did not end when the announcement said. KBB reported that production would end at the close of twenty twenty-three. Wikipedia says the last TRX was produced on the sixteenth of February twenty twenty-four. By our arithmetic, that is forty-seven days after the end of the year, though the two statements may not describe exactly the same milestone.
scenes.caption: KBB (AUG 2023): PRODUCTION ENDS 'AT THE CLOSE OF 2023' · WIKIPEDIA: LAST TRX BUILT 16 FEB 2024 → +47 DAYS (OUR ARITHMETIC; MILESTONES MAY DIFFER)

scenes.text: How long did the first run last? Wikipedia's infobox gives production from December twenty twenty to February twenty twenty-four. By our arithmetic, that is thirty-eight months, or three years and two months. It also lists about eleven and a half thousand units across all trims and editions, by our sum from the page's figures, many of them approximate.
scenes.caption: DEC 2020 → FEB 2024 = 38 MONTHS = 3 YR 2 MO (WIKIPEDIA INFOBOX; OUR ARITHMETIC) · ~11,494 UNITS IN OUR SUM OF WIKIPEDIA'S FIGURES (SEVERAL APPROXIMATE)

scenes.text: The Final Edition alone, at four thousand, was a large share of that. By our arithmetic, it is about thirty-five percent of the page's listed units. Ram's last act, in other words, was to build more of one edition than any other, and it did so with a sticker about twenty-two percent above the standard truck.
scenes.caption: 4,000 ÷ 11,494 = 34.8% OF LISTED UNITS · $119,620 vs $97,730 = +22.4% (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Hagerty gives yet another price. It says the TRX started at eighty-seven thousand, six hundred ninety-five dollars. Motor1 gives ninety-seven thousand, seven hundred thirty for the twenty twenty-four standard truck, and MotorTrend gave eighty-five thousand, seven hundred eighty-five for twenty twenty-three. Three sources, three starting prices, and we do not know which model year Hagerty meant.
scenes.caption: HAGERTY (NOV 2023): TRX 'STARTED AT $87,695' · MOTOR1: 2024 STANDARD $97,730 · MOTORTREND: 2023 BASE $85,785 · MODEL YEAR OF HAGERTY FIGURE NOT STATED

scenes.text: The replacement had a name before it had a spec sheet. Hagerty quoted Kuniskis calling the Ram 1500 RHO essentially a TRX, with the Hurricane engine in place of the supercharged Hemi. He said it should cost less than the TRX because it would be down on power. Hagerty expected it sometime in the third quarter of twenty twenty-four.
scenes.caption: HAGERTY, 8 NOV 2023: KUNISKIS: RHO 'ESSENTIALLY A TRX' WITH HURRICANE · PRICE TO BE LOWER · EXPECTED Q3 2024

scenes.text: The engine is the three litre Hurricane inline-six. Hagerty says the standard version makes four hundred twenty horsepower and four hundred sixty-nine pound-feet, and the high-output version five hundred forty and five hundred twenty-one, with up to twenty-eight psi of boost. By our arithmetic, the high-output version has one hundred twenty more horsepower, twenty-nine percent.
scenes.caption: STANDARD HURRICANE 420 HP / 469 LB-FT · HIGH OUTPUT 540 HP / 521 LB-FT, UP TO 28 PSI (HAGERTY) · +120 HP = +28.6% (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Against the TRX, the RHO gives up power. By our arithmetic, five hundred forty is one hundred sixty-two horsepower, or twenty-three percent, below seven hundred two. Its torque, five hundred twenty-one, is one hundred twenty-nine pound-feet, or twenty percent, below six hundred fifty. Motor1 calls the RHO a different market, with less power and likely a lower price.
scenes.caption: 540 vs 702 HP = −162 (−23.1%) · 521 vs 650 LB-FT = −129 (−19.8%) (OUR ARITHMETIC) · MOTOR1: 'A DIFFERENT MARKET'

scenes.text: SlashGear lists the twenty twenty-five RHO starting at sixty-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-five dollars, with up to fifteen miles per gallon combined. By our arithmetic, that is twenty-seven thousand, seven hundred thirty-five dollars below the standard TRX at ninety-seven thousand, seven hundred thirty, and it rates three miles per gallon better than the TRX's twelve.
scenes.caption: RHO $69,995, UP TO 15 MPG COMBINED (SLASHGEAR) · $97,730 − $69,995 = $27,735 (−28.4%) · 15 − 12 = 3 MPG (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Wikipedia says the RHO is not a direct successor, and that Ram is phasing out the six point two, six point four and five point seven litre Hemi engines in favour of the Hurricane, except in the heavy-duty trucks. Yahoo's Auto Wire says the twenty twenty-six Ram 1500 still offers a five point seven Hemi with eTorque at three hundred ninety-five horsepower.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: RHO 'NOT A DIRECT SUCCESSOR' · 6.2/6.4/5.7 HEMIS BEING PHASED OUT FOR HURRICANE (EXCEPT HD) · AUTO WIRE: 2026 RAM 1500 STILL OFFERS 5.7 HEMI eTORQUE, 395 HP

scenes.text: There is one more price comparison. Autoblog reports that the twenty twenty-seven TRX, at ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-five dollars, is about twenty-six thousand more than the base RHO. By our arithmetic, that implies a base RHO around seventy-four thousand. That differs from SlashGear's sixty-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-five, probably because they describe different model years.
scenes.caption: AUTOBLOG: 2027 TRX ≈ $26,000 MORE THAN BASE RHO → RHO ≈ $73,995 (OUR ARITHMETIC) vs SLASHGEAR $69,995 · $4,000 APART · MODEL YEARS LIKELY DIFFER

scenes.text: Between the end and the return, the word that appears is shelf. Hagerty, in November twenty twenty-three, quotes Kuniskis saying the TRX name will go on the shelf. And American Cars And Racing, in July twenty twenty-five, reports he described the TRX as on the shelf when production ended, rather than discontinued. The same word, twenty months apart.
scenes.caption: KUNISKIS: 'WILL GO ON THE SHELF' (HAGERTY, NOV 2023) · 'ON THE SHELF', NOT DISCONTINUED (AMERICAN CARS AND RACING, JULY 2025) · 20 MONTHS APART (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Wikipedia says that in July twenty twenty-five, Stellantis chief executive Antonio Filosa confirmed the TRX would return. And Motor1 and others say the return came alongside the revival of Ram's SRT performance division. Autoblog adds that Kuniskis said his early twenty twenty-five priorities were reviving the Hemi V-8 and reigniting SRT.
scenes.caption: JULY 2025: STELLANTIS CEO ANTONIO FILOSA CONFIRMS TRX RETURN (WIKIPEDIA) · RETURN TIED TO SRT REVIVAL (MOTOR1) · KUNISKIS: EARLY-2025 PRIORITIES = REVIVE HEMI + SRT (AOL/AUTOBLOG)

scenes.text: On the sixth of January twenty twenty-six, the Auto Wire reported on a fifteen-second Ram teaser with the tagline Power Will Be Reborn, saying Ram had confirmed only a reveal on the first of January. The dates do not fit: the article is dated five days after the reveal it describes. We use it only for the rumour it records, a figure of seven hundred ninety-seven horsepower.
scenes.caption: AUTO WIRE (YAHOO), 6 JAN 2026: 15-SEC TEASER 'POWER WILL BE REBORN' · REVEAL 'JAN 1' (ARTICLE IS DATED 5 DAYS AFTER IT) · RUMOUR: 797 HP (UNNAMED SOURCES)

scenes.text: The rumour was higher than the truth. The release says seven hundred seventy-seven. By our arithmetic, the rumour was twenty horsepower, or two and a half percent, too high. It is a small reminder that preview numbers are not announcements, and that the first TRX also had a pre-launch figure of seven hundred seven that turned out to be seven hundred two.
scenes.caption: RUMOUR 797 vs ANNOUNCED 777 → +20 HP = +2.6% · FIRST TRX: 707 REPORTED vs 702 ACTUAL (AUTO WIRE; RAM; WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Ram unveiled the twenty twenty-seven Ram 1500 SRT TRX on the first of January twenty twenty-six, with seven hundred seventy-seven horsepower and six hundred eighty pound-feet, according to Ram's release. By our arithmetic, that is twenty-two months and sixteen days after the last TRX was built on the sixteenth of February twenty twenty-four.
scenes.caption: UNVEILED 1 JAN 2026: 777 HP / 680 LB-FT (RAM) · 16 FEB 2024 → 1 JAN 2026 = 22 MONTHS 16 DAYS (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: AOL's article, which carries Ram's release, says the original TRX left production after twenty twenty-four as Stellantis shifted toward more efficient powertrains and electrification. It says the change followed the drastic shift in United States emissions regulations, but it does not name the rules. We repeat that wording as the article's own, and we do not know which rules it means.
scenes.caption: AOL: TRX LEFT PRODUCTION AS STELLANTIS SHIFTED TO EFFICIENCY/ELECTRIFICATION; RETURN 'FOLLOWED THE DRASTIC SHIFT IN U.S. EMISSIONS REGULATIONS' · NO RULE NAMED · WE DO NOT KNOW WHICH

scenes.text: Autoblog reports that Kuniskis told The Drive that anyone who wants a daily driver should choose the RHO: If you want to drive this every single day as your only truck, the RHO is a way better option. For a weekend performance truck with price no object, he said, choose the TRX. He also ruled out a rumoured single-cab variant with a six point four litre Hemi and a manual gearbox.
scenes.caption: KUNISKIS (THE DRIVE, VIA AUTOBLOG, 14 JAN 2026): DAILY DRIVER → RHO 'A WAY BETTER OPTION' · WEEKEND PERFORMANCE TRUCK → TRX · RULED OUT SINGLE-CAB 6.4 HEMI MANUAL RUMOUR
scenes.orig_query: Kuniskis on who the TRX is for

scenes.text: Ram's release claims the new truck is the fastest and most powerful production gas pickup in the world. It claims zero to sixty in three point five seconds with launch control. And the AOL article says that is one second faster than the outgoing model, though earlier tests by Cars dot com and MotorTrend measured four point one and three point nine, so the true improvement is smaller than a second.
scenes.caption: RAM CLAIMS: FASTEST/MOST POWERFUL GAS PICKUP · 0–60 3.5 S · AOL: '1 S FASTER' THAN OLD TRX · MEASURED OLD TRX: 4.1 S (CARS.COM) AND 3.9 S (MOTORTREND) → 0.4–0.6 S IMPROVEMENT ON THOSE (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: The price is where the TRX story rejoins the money. Ram's release says ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-five dollars plus twenty-five ninety-five, and AOL gives one hundred two thousand, five hundred ninety. AOL says the Raptor R starts at one hundred thirteen thousand, five hundred twenty-five, while Autoblog's page estimated it at one hundred ten thousand, nine hundred thirty. We cannot settle which number is current.
scenes.caption: TRX $99,995 + $2,595 = $102,590 (RAM; AOL) · RAPTOR R $113,525 (AOL) vs $110,930 (AUTOBLOG) · $2,595 DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE RAPTOR R FIGURES (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: When asked by The Drive how long the TRX will stay on the market, Kuniskis answered: Call Washington. We do not know exactly what he meant, and our sources do not explain it. In context, it reads as a reference to regulation. But that is our interpretation, and it is the only place in our sources where he comes close to naming the cause.
scenes.caption: KUNISKIS (THE DRIVE, JUNE 2026): 'CALL WASHINGTON' · MEANING NOT EXPLAINED · 'REFERS TO REGULATION' = OUR INTERPRETATION

scenes.text: Timing. Ram's release says the truck arrives in the second half of twenty twenty-six, and The Drive reports order books opened on a Monday, in an article dated the twenty-second of June. By our arithmetic, from the end of production in February twenty twenty-four to the order opening, that is about two years and four months.
scenes.caption: ARRIVAL 2H 2026 (RAM) · ORDERS OPEN MONDAY 22 JUNE 2026 (THE DRIVE) · 16 FEB 2024 → 22 JUN 2026 ≈ 2 YR 4 MO (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Put the key numbers in a row. The first TRX, seven hundred two horsepower, in twenty twenty-one. The RHO that replaced it, five hundred forty. The revived TRX, seven hundred seventy-seven. By our arithmetic, the new truck has seventy-five horsepower more than the old one, and two hundred thirty-seven more than the RHO, or forty-four percent more.
scenes.caption: TRX 702 → RHO 540 → TRX 2027 777 · 777 − 702 = +75 · 777 − 540 = +237 = +43.9% (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: The Auto Wire says Ford raised the Raptor R to seven hundred twenty horsepower starting with the twenty twenty-four model year. That puts the Raptor R's increase in the same window as the TRX's gap. By our arithmetic, while the TRX was away, the Ford gained twenty horsepower, and the returning Ram answered with fifty-seven more than that.
scenes.caption: AUTO WIRE: RAPTOR R TO 720 HP FROM MY2024 · +20 HP vs 700 · 2027 TRX 777 − 720 = +57 (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: And the story keeps a loop: Wikipedia says the twenty twenty-seven power increase was meant to make the TRX more competitive with the Raptor R. Ram's release says the numbers beat the nearest competitor by fifty-seven horsepower and forty pound-feet. By our arithmetic, that matches the Ford's seven hundred twenty and six hundred forty exactly.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: INCREASE 'MORE COMPETITIVE WITH THE RAPTOR R' · RAM: +57 HP / +40 LB-FT vs NEAREST RIVAL → 720 / 640 = RAPTOR R FIGURES (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: A last piece of the story is how much the TRX name matters. Kuniskis said he would never call a lesser truck the same name. Ram then launched the RHO under a different name, and brought the TRX name back only when the power exceeded the original. Whether that was a plan from the start, our sources cannot tell us. It is consistent with his words.
scenes.caption: KUNISKIS (HAGERTY): WOULD NEVER USE THE NAME 'DOWN IN POWER' · RHO LAUNCHED UNDER OTHER NAME · TRX NAME RETURNED AT 777 HP > 702 HP · WHETHER PLANNED: NOT STATED (OUR OBSERVATION)

scenes.text: To judge why the TRX mattered, go back to what it beat. SlashGear says the TRX's seven hundred two horsepower and six hundred fifty pound-feet were two hundred fifty-two horsepower and one hundred forty pound-feet more than the twenty twenty-one Ford F one fifty Raptor. By our arithmetic, that checks out against the Raptor's four hundred fifty and five hundred ten, and it is fifty-six percent more horsepower.
scenes.caption: TRX 702 / 650 vs 2021 RAPTOR 450 / 510 → +252 HP (+56.0%) · +140 LB-FT (SLASHGEAR; WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC CHECK)
scenes.chapter: What the TRX was up against

scenes.text: Measured numbers are a mess. Ram claimed zero to sixty in four point five seconds. Cars dot com measured four point one. MotorTrend measured three point nine on a twenty twenty-three truck. SlashGear cites a Car and Driver test of three point seven, with a quarter mile of twelve point three, though we could not open that test ourselves. Four numbers, a spread of eight tenths.
scenes.caption: 0–60: 4.5 S (RAM CLAIM) · 4.1 S (CARS.COM) · 3.9 S (MOTORTREND) · 3.7 S (CAR AND DRIVER, CITED BY SLASHGEAR; NOT VERIFIED) → SPREAD 0.8 S (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Then the Hellephant. Wikipedia says a one thousand horsepower crate engine of that name was shown at SEMA in twenty eighteen, and that Mopar said it was not for street use. By our arithmetic, the new factory TRX is two hundred twenty-three horsepower short of it. It shows that the Hemi family had power in reserve, and that the production number was a decision.
scenes.caption: HELLEPHANT: 1,000 HP CRATE ENGINE, SEMA 2018, 'NOT FOR STREET USE' (WIKIPEDIA) · 1,000 − 777 = 223 HP (OUR ARITHMETIC) · 'PRODUCTION NUMBER WAS A DECISION' = OUR OBSERVATION

scenes.text: Look at the whole span. The concept appeared in October twenty sixteen. The last of the first generation was built in February twenty twenty-four, about seven years and four months later. And the revived truck was unveiled in January twenty twenty-six, about nine years and three months after the concept. The TRX name has been alive, in one form or another, for about nine years.
scenes.caption: CONCEPT OCT 2016 → LAST TRX 16 FEB 2024 ≈ 7 YR 4 MO → REVIVAL 1 JAN 2026 ≈ 9 YR 3 MO AFTER CONCEPT (OUR ARITHMETIC; CONCEPT DAY NOT GIVEN)

scenes.text: Remember the numbers behind the end. Edmunds estimates fuel as thirty-seven percent of the TRX's five-year cost to own, the largest single line, and the truck is rated twelve miles per gallon combined. The truck's owners accepted that. But a company that sells hundreds of thousands of other vehicles, and has a corporate emissions goal, may weigh it differently. That is our reading.
scenes.caption: EDMUNDS: FUEL = 37.3% OF TRX 5-YR COST ($38,093 OF $102,208) · 12 MPG COMBINED (KBB) · COMPANY-LEVEL WEIGHING = OUR READING, NOT A SOURCED CLAIM

scenes.text: A note on the names. Wikipedia calls the returning truck both the Ram 1500 TRX and the Ram 1500 SRT TRX. Ram's release says the twenty twenty-seven Ram 1500 SRT TRX. Motor1 says new SRT and T-Rex badging. The page of Wikipedia also says the TRX would return for the twenty twenty-six model year, then says it was unveiled on the first of January twenty twenty-six as a twenty twenty-seven model. Both statements are on the page.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 'RAM 1500 TRX' AND 'RAM 1500 SRT TRX' · RETURN 'FOR MY2026' (JULY 2025) vs UNVEILED 1 JAN 2026 AS MY2027 · RAM RELEASE: 2027 RAM 1500 SRT TRX

scenes.text: Production timing is loose too. American Cars And Racing reported in July twenty twenty-five, citing Mopar Insiders, that production was reportedly scheduled to start in late January twenty twenty-six. Ram's release says arrival in the second half of the year. And The Drive says orders opened on a Monday in June. By our arithmetic, from late January to the order opening on the twenty-second of June is about five months.
scenes.caption: REPORTED PRODUCTION START: LATE JAN 2026 (AMERICAN CARS AND RACING, CITING MOPAR INSIDERS) · ARRIVAL 2H 2026 (RAM) · ORDERS 22 JUNE 2026 (THE DRIVE) → ≈ 5 MONTHS (OUR ARITHMETIC) · ACTUAL START: NOT CONFIRMED

scenes.text: The Ram 1500 range matters here too. The Auto Wire says the twenty twenty-six Ram 1500 offers the five point seven litre Hemi with eTorque at three hundred ninety-five horsepower, and the twin-turbo inline-six at five hundred forty. By our arithmetic, five hundred forty is one hundred forty-five more than the Hemi. Neither is a supercharged V8, which is the engine that made the TRX what it was.
scenes.caption: 2026 RAM 1500: 5.7 HEMI eTORQUE 395 HP · TWIN-TURBO I6 540 HP (AUTO WIRE) · 540 − 395 = 145 HP (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Kuniskis's slogan deserves a note. In Ram's release he said SRT does not limbo; we high-jump, and seven twenty-one was not going to cut it. By our arithmetic, seven twenty-one is exactly one horsepower more than the Raptor R's seven hundred twenty. The release does not explain the number, so that link is our inference, but the arithmetic is suggestive.
scenes.caption: KUNISKIS (RAM RELEASE): 'SRT DOESN'T LIMBO; WE HIGH-JUMP—AND 721 WASN'T GOING TO CUT IT' · 721 = RAPTOR R'S 720 + 1 (OUR ARITHMETIC) · LINK = OUR INFERENCE; RELEASE DOES NOT EXPLAIN 721

scenes.text: And Ford's side of the loop. Forbes reports that Ford racing executive Will Ford said hybrid might allow Ford to keep the V8 alive a little longer. Ford chief executive Jim Farley spoke of more hybridization on the performance side. Both companies are working in the same regulatory climate, and both are still trying to keep a supercharged V8 truck on sale.
scenes.caption: FORBES, 25 JAN 2026: WILL FORD: HYBRID 'MIGHT ALLOW US TO KEEP THE V8 ALIVE A LITTLE LONGER' · JIM FARLEY: 'MORE HYBRIDIZATION ... ON THE PERFORMANCE SIDE' · 'SAME CLIMATE' = OUR READING

scenes.text: What is missing. Ram's own, complete explanation of why the TRX ended. The specific regulation that Wikipedia and AOL refer to. Why production ran about six weeks beyond the announced end of the year. Why the Hellcat engine, announced as ending in twenty twenty-three, returned. And any statement about how long the new truck will stay on sale.
scenes.caption: NOT IN OUR SOURCES: RAM'S FULL OWN EXPLANATION · THE SPECIFIC REGULATION · WHY PRODUCTION RAN PAST YEAR-END · WHY THE HELLCAT RETURNED · HOW LONG THE 2027 TRX WILL LAST
scenes.chapter: What our sources do not say

scenes.text: So the story, as the record gives it. Ram announced an ending in twenty twenty-three, built a Final Edition of four thousand, shelved the name, sold a weaker truck under a new name, and brought the TRX back at a higher power once the company decided to revive its Hemi and its SRT division. The cause that links them is probably regulation, but nobody we found says so in full.
scenes.caption: SEQUENCE: 2023 END ANNOUNCED → 4,000 FINAL EDITION → NAME SHELVED → RHO 540 HP → 2025 RETURN CONFIRMED → 2026 777 HP · CAUSE: 'PROBABLY REGULATION' = OUR READING, NOT SOURCED IN FULL

scenes.text: Did Ram do the right thing by bringing it back? Tell us in the comments. In the other videos of this series, we reveal two things you did not know about the TRX, compare it with the Raptor R, and add up what it really costs to own. Our twenty twenty-seven Truck Buyer's Guide is linked in the description. Subscribe to Pickup Reality.
scenes.caption: SUBSCRIBE: PICKUP REALITY
